dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estadistica port and maritime datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estadística: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estadística. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Transporte marítimo y por vías navegables interiores (División 50 CNAE; Total de viajeros por tipo, medio de transporte (terrestre, aéreo y ma. Formats seen: CSV, HTML, PC-AXIS, JSON, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.ine.es/aviso_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
